issue.title: Coverage-contexts baseline availability beyond 14-day retention
issue.description: The sase-coverage-contexts artifact that seeds diff-scoped selection's coverage-context ground truth has 14-day GitHub Actions retention and is published on master pushes only. A workspace idle longer than 14 days silently falls back to the static import-graph closure with no signal that context-based selection is degraded. Consider a scheduled refresh job independent of master pushes, longer artifact retention, or a just selection-health warning when no baseline is within retention. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3), originally proposed during sase-fp.6 (Coverage-context ground truth for selection).
